name: Collateral Data 33
definition: Provides the details of the collateral used in the transaction.

NetExposureCollateralisationIndicator.name: Net Exposure Collateralisation Indicator
NetExposureCollateralisationIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the collateral has been provided for a net exposure, rather than for a single transaction.

ComponentType.name: Component Type
ComponentType.definition: Indication of the type of collateral component.

CashCollateralCurrency.name: Cash Collateral Currency
CashCollateralCurrency.definition: Currency of unit of cash collateral component.

PriceCurrency.name: Price Currency
PriceCurrency.definition: Currency of price of unit of collateral component.

Quality.name: Quality
Quality.definition: Code that classifies the risk of the security.

IssuerJurisdiction.name: Issuer Jurisdiction
IssuerJurisdiction.definition: Jurisdiction of the issuer of the security used as collateral.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Classification of the type of the security.

TradeRepository.name: Trade Repository
TradeRepository.definition: Trade Repository to which the other counterparty reported.

ReconciliationFlag.name: Reconciliation Flag
ReconciliationFlag.definition: List of possible values for TRs reconciliation purposes.

ReinvestedCash.name: Reinvested Cash
ReinvestedCash.definition: Provides details on the type and amount of the cash reinvestment in a given currency.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: Following Must be True|	/NetExposureCollateralisationIndicator Must be present| Or	/ComponentType Must be present| Or	/CashCollateralCurrency Must be present| Or	/PriceCurrency Must be present| Or /Quality Must be present| Or /Maturity Must be present| Or /IssuerJurisdiction Must be present| Or /Type Must be present| Or /TradeRepository Must be present| Or /ReconciliationFlag Must be present| Or /ReinvestedCash Must be present
